h1: Industrial and Warehouse Steel Buildings in Wyoming, Utah & Idaho
answer: Brooks Steel Buildings supplies custom pre-engineered steel buildings for warehouses, fabrication and manufacturing shops, and heavy-duty storage. Every building is designed around your crane loads, door openings, and clear-span needs, and engineered for your site’s snow and wind loads.
intro_h2: Industrial Buildings Designed Around Your Operation
intro_p: Industrial and warehouse buildings work hard. Wide open floors, tall eaves, large door openings, and overhead cranes all affect how the structure is engineered, so we start with how you will use the building. Explore dimensions, rooflines, colors, and openings in our 3D designer before you call. Need office space with your warehouse? See our Steel Flex Buildings page.

faq_h2: Industrial and Warehouse Steel Building Questions
faq: What is an industrial steel building?
An industrial steel building is a custom pre-engineered building for warehouses, shops, manufacturing, and heavy storage, designed around your equipment, openings, and loads.
Can you design a steel building for an overhead crane?
Yes. We design the building to your crane loads. Tell us the crane type, capacity, runway layout, and hook height you need, and the building frame is engineered to carry it.
What types of cranes can the building be designed for?

We design for top-running bridge cranes, underhung bridge cranes, monorails, jib cranes, and gantry or semi-gantry systems. The right design depends on the crane’s capacity, span, and how often it runs. Your crane supplier provides the crane loads.
Do you supply overhead doors and loading dock doors?

No. We do supply commercial walk doors (man doors), but overhead, roll-up, and dock doors are not included. We design and frame the building for them, and they are installed by a door installer. Tell us the door types and sizes so the openings are designed correctly.
How wide and tall can an industrial steel building be?

Clear-span steel buildings can be designed with wide open floors and tall eaves. The practical size depends on your loads, site, and design. Tell us the size and clearances you need and we will plan the building around them.
Can the building be designed for rooftop equipment, solar, or sprinklers?
Yes. Tell us about rooftop equipment, solar, sprinkler systems, or high-piled storage so the extra loads are included in the design.
Can I add on to the building later?
Yes. Steel buildings can often be designed so bays or lean-tos can be added later. Let us know your plans so the design allows for it.

How long does it take to get an industrial steel building?
